The prompt hint now tells you how to bring back a question or plan card hidden by a folded band, and advisor calls on `/desk-activity` use your theme's error color so they stand out.

- When the band above the prompt is folded (`ctrl+x ctrl+a` or `[-]`), the engine hides the question and plan cards with it, so a question looked like it never came. While a card is waiting, the hint line now starts with `hidden? ctrl+x ctrl+a`, and keeps it even after you type in the prompt
- The advisor bar, legend and row label on `/desk-activity` use the theme's `error` color instead of `warning`, which many themes draw in the same blue as other bars

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
